# Potted plant: a terracotta pot (eight-sided, tapering) with a rim and seven pointed strap leaves
# fanning out. 2.4 m across, 2.7 m tall. Origin on the ground under the pot. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Pot --base-color 0.8784 0.5529 0.3176 --no-slot
material new Soil --base-color 0.2706 0.1686 0.2471 --no-slot
material new Leaf --base-color 0.3765 0.6118 0.3098 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name Pot --vertices 8 --radius1 0.5 --radius2 0.66 --depth 0.9 --location 0 0 0.45
add mesh cylinder --name Rim --vertices 8 --radius 0.76 --depth 0.22 --location 0 0 0.95
select Pot Rim
active Pot
join
material assign Pot
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Soil --vertices 8 --radius 0.62 --depth 0.05 --location 0 0 1.03
material assign Soil
add mesh cube --name L0 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.42 0.12 1.6
apply --scale
translate 0 0 0.800
apply --location
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 1.35"
scale 0.2 1 1
mode object
set rotation 22 0 20.0
apply --rotation
translate 0 0 0.95
apply --location
add mesh cube --name L1 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.42 0.12 1.35
apply --scale
translate 0 0 0.675
apply --location
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 1.10"
scale 0.2 1 1
mode object
set rotation 38 0 71.4
apply --rotation
translate 0 0 0.95
apply --location

apply --scale
translate 0 0 0.800
